person:elros.note: Founds Armenelos as the royal city and rules Númenor from it as the first king.
Is laid to rest in the royal tombs near the Meneltarma, as were the later kings.

person:tar-aldarion.note: Sails from this eastern haven with the Guild of Venturers on his voyages to Middle-earth.
Plants great woods in the south-east to supply timber for his ships.
Builds the White House in Emerië as a home for Erendis.
Builds the Light-tower Calmindon on the isle of Tol Uinen.
Takes the sceptre in S.A. 883 and reigns from Armenelos until S.A. 1075.

person:erendis.note: Leaves Armenelos and lives in Emerië, a land of sheep-pastures, apart from Aldarion.
Lives in the White House that Aldarion built, later apart from him.
Comes to the court at Armenelos, where she is betrothed and wed to Aldarion.

person:tar-ancalime.note: Is raised by Erendis in her home in Emerië.
Goes for a time to the household of Hallatan, her father's kinsman, at Hyarastorni.
Becomes the first ruling queen of Númenor in S.A. 1075 and rules from Armenelos.

person:tar-palantir.note: Reigns from Armenelos from S.A. 3177 and seeks to restore the friendship with the Valar.

person:tar-miriel.note: Is forced to wed Ar-Pharazôn at Armenelos and is queen there until the Downfall.

person:ar-pharazon.note: Seizes the sceptre in S.A. 3255 and rules from Armenelos.
Has the White Tree Nimloth cut down at the urging of Sauron.
Worships Melkor in the great temple raised by Sauron.

person:sauron.note: Is brought to Númenor as a hostage and wins the trust of Ar-Pharazôn.
Has the great temple raised on the hill in the midst of Armenelos.

person:amandil.note: Holds the title of Lord of Andúnië, the last of that line, and leads the Faithful.
Dwells at Rómenna in the last days and sails from the east coast into the West alone.

person:elendil.note: Dwells among the Faithful at Rómenna and readies ships before the Downfall.

person:isildur.note: Takes a fruit of the White Tree by night before it is felled and is wounded.
Waits with the ships of the Faithful at Rómenna before the Downfall.

person:anarion.note: Lives among the Faithful at Rómenna with Elendil and Isildur.

thing:nimloth.note: Grows in the courts of the King's House at Armenelos, held sacred by the kings.
Is felled by order of Ar-Pharazôn and burned in the temple.

thing:sceptre-of-annuminas.note: Is the token of the Lords of Andúnië, who were of the line of Elros.
